messages:
Ava (CSM): Hey team — flagging ACME onboarding SLO acceptance. Customer expects 99.95% uptime and p95 latency < 220ms for /generate. They hit two failing checks in the past 48h, need an evidence bundle + remediation notes before Friday's readout.
Diego (Ops): Which window should I pull? Since go-live or last 7 days?
Ava (CSM): Both. Since go-live for trend + last 7 days for recent signal. Include canary config, warmup runs, and KV cache hit rates.
Riya (CS Eng): On it. I'll run this query and attach results:
```sql
SELECT service, count(*) AS incidents, avg(latency_ms) AS avg_ms, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95
FROM requests
WHERE customer_id='acme' AND ts >= '2025-03-01'
GROUP BY service;
```
Sofia (Enablement): Customer feedback: onboarding docs didn't make warmup expectations clear. I captured their bullet list in the feedback form: https://confluence/redwood/acme-onboard-feedback — I'll turn that into a one-pager.
Mark (AE): This is a renewal signal — risk if unresolved. Can someone confirm the credit calc? We discussed pro-rated latency credits up to 1% ARR equivalent last week.
Diego (Ops): Quick note: p95 spikes line up with their nightly DB maintenance (02:00 UTC). Calling that out will help. I'll collect console traces and per-route dashboards.
Ava (CSM): @infra-bot can you export traces for ACME between 2025-03-10 and 2025-03-17?
infra-bot: export started: /exports/4897654322-acme-traces.zip (ETA ~90s)
Riya (CS Eng): Uploading latency histogram CSV and a short script I used to compute p95:
```python
# compute p95
import numpy as np
p95 = np.percentile(latencies, 95)
print(p95)
```
Sofia (Enablement): I'll draft the customer note explaining warmup, cache behavior, and suggested configuration changes (enable prefix caching + staggered warmup). Will include before/after expectation.
Mark (AE): I'll draft the credit proposal and loop in finance for approval. Need evidence bundle by EOD Thursday to include in renewal packet.
Ava (CSM): Owners: Diego — evidence export & screenshots; Riya — analysis; Sofia — customer comms; Mark — commercial/credits. I'll own the readout.
Diego (Ops): Created Jira CS-8342 to track evidence bundle. ETA Thu 16:00 PT. Assigned to me.
Riya (CS Eng): Quick ask — do we issue credits automatically after we validate, or after finance signs off?
Mark (AE): After review + finance approval. I'll ping finance when draft is ready.
Sofia (Enablement): I'll capture the feedback bullets in Confluence and add a short enablement runbook for the customer-facing onboarding session.
Ava (CSM): Also add a small acceptance checkbox for customers to confirm SLO targets during signoff — link to the acceptance form in the readout pack.
Diego (Ops): Export complete: /exports/4897654322-acme-traces.zip
Ava (CSM): Perfect — thanks all. Will consolidate into the readout doc and share with ACME for signoff. :thumbsup:
